request: Improve this model against the drawing and the renders, following the QUALITY rules. The side view is the weakest (IoU 0.83): make the body's upper and lower outline follow side_top(u) and side_bottom(u) closely along the whole length (no upturned tail flick, no extra waves at the nose), keep the wheel centres and radii where the side view draws them, and size the headlights as drawn. Keep everything that already matches.

rounds.plan: Body lofted through 41 measured stations using cleaned side_top/side_bottom exactly (only windscreen/roll-bar spikes and tyre ground-touch dips replaced, no global smoothing), then intersected with a side-profile prism splined through the same measured top/bottom points so the side silhouette follows the drawing along the whole length with no tail flick or nose waves. Wheel centres (x=0.205L front, 0.775L rear) and R415 radii kept as drawn. Headlights resized as drawn (176mm bucket / 152mm lamp). All other features kept: cockpit, seats, steering, roll bar, windscreen frame+glass, scoop, grille, lights, bumpers, exhausts, mirror.

Front on the right in the drawn side/plan views (u = 1 - x/LENGTH; x=0 is the front in the program frame). Main body is a smooth non-ruled loft through end-clustered measured stations whose super-ellipse sections use the cleaned side_top/side_bottom and half_width profiles exactly (only windscreen/roll-bar spikes and tyre ground-touch dips cleaned, no global smoothing, no prism intersection), giving the measured side silhouette with no tail flick or nose waves. Wheel centres/radii are taken from the side_bottom wheel dips (front x=0.19L, rear x=0.76L, R415 tyres touching the ground) and headlights are sized from the front-view circles (~0.11 of width). All other visible features (cockpit, seats, windscreen frame+glass, roll bar, scoop, grille, lights, bumpers, mirror, exhausts) are kept from the previous model at their drawn positions.

Body lofted from measured side/plan profiles, then trimmed by side- and plan-profile prisms sampled exactly from cleaned side_top/side_bottom and half_width so the side (weakest, 0.844) and top silhouettes follow the drawing with no loft overshoot, tail flick or nose waves. Wheel centres (x=0.19L front, 0.76L rear) and R415 radii kept as drawn; headlight diameter kept as drawn (172mm lamp in 196mm bucket) but pushed forward proud of the nose. Added as separate parts: four wheels (ring tyre, brake disc, open chrome rim ring with hub and five spokes) sized to the drawn wheel circles and touching the ground, trapezoidal chrome windscreen frame with separate glass pane at the cowl, hollow cockpit with floor, dashboard, two leather seats, steering wheel and column, gear lever, driver roll hoop with diagonal and rear braces, bonnet scoop and intake, fuel cap, oval grille, headlight buckets and lamps sized from the front view and sitting proud of the nose, indicators, tail lights, side vents, door handles, stalk mirror, front bumper, rear overriders and side exhausts.
